parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Compare the relative acidities of benzoic acid ($\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOH}$), phenylmethanol ($\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$), and phenol ($\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{OH}$).
Explain your reasoning.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Benzoyl chloride, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COCl}$, can be synthesised by the reaction of benzoic acid with either $\text{PCl}_5$ or $\text{SOCl}_2$.

$$\text{reaction 1} \quad \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOH} + \text{ PCl}_5 \rightarrow \text{ C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COCl} + \ldots\ldots + \ldots\ldots$$

Complete the equations for these reactions.

$$\text{reaction 2} \quad \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOH} + \text{ SOCl}_2 \rightarrow \text{ C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COCl} + \ldots\ldots + \ldots\ldots$$

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Use your answer to (c)(i) to suggest why it is easier to isolate, in a pure form, the $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COCl}$ from reaction 2 compared to reaction 1.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem: Benzoyl chloride is hydrolysed by water at room temperature to form benzoic acid.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Name the type of mechanism you showed in (d)(i).
